verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Crossplane itself issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials or tokens for an agent. RBAC is described as a Kubernetes control-plane feature that Crossplane builds on, which is a host-platform capability. Encapsulating permissions behind a custom API layer for AI agents is an adjacent guardrail concept, not credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
